name: GPU-Node-Agent
description: Exposes deep hardware telemetry for a high-performance compute node.

capabilities.name: Processor Telemetry
capabilities.description: Returns CPU architecture, load averages, utilization, and frequencies.

capabilities.name: Accelerator Telemetry
capabilities.description: Returns GPU details, thermals, power draw, memory, and utilization.

capabilities.name: Memory Telemetry
capabilities.description: Returns unified memory capacity, active usage, and swap details.

capabilities.name: Storage Telemetry
capabilities.description: Returns NVMe capacities, mount points, and I/O counters.

capabilities.name: Network Telemetry
capabilities.description: Returns network interface statistics, packets, and throughput.
